title: Northbridge private rollout sync - scratch notes
content:
Meeting: Northbridge Private Deployment — Weekly Sync (prep & realtime notes)
Date: 2025-03-11
Attendees: Maya Chen (Redwood), Alex Rivera (Redwood SE), Priya Patel (Redwood PM), Liam O'Connor (Northbridge Infra), Sara Kim (Northbridge SecOps)
Meeting objective: Review milestones for on-prem rollout, confirm network/VPC handoff tasks, triage blockers, and assign owners for next week's deliverables.

Quick status summary:
- Overall: On track-ish. Core runtime builds deployed to stage, but environmental parity gaps remain for KMS and firewall rules. Northbridge is green on hardware procurement (3 racks arriving 2025-03-18).
- Risk hotspots: KMS integration (medium-high), corporate proxy + egress filtering affecting model downloads (high), load-testing gap for 90th percentile latency (medium).

Milestones and owners (condensed):
- Stage infra provisioned (k8s, ingress, storage) — Owner: Liam O'Connor (Customer) — Target: 2025-03-12 — Status: blocked (ingress certificate not issued)
- KMS/HSM integration PoC — Owner: Alex Rivera (Redwood) & Sara Kim (Customer) — Target: 2025-03-14 — Status: in_progress
- Model artifact transfer process (s3 presigned to internal registry) — Owner: Maya Chen (Redwood) — Target: 2025-03-16 — Status: in_progress
- Network ACLs & egress rules for model pull and telemetry — Owner: Liam O'Connor — Target: 2025-03-13 — Status: blocked (audit firewall rules)
- Load/runbook validation (smoke tests + perf harness) — Owner: Priya Patel — Target: 2025-03-20 — Status: pending

Blockers discussed:
1) Certificate Authority for internal ingress: Customer's internal CA requires CSR workflow that our helm chart does not currently automate. Next step: Maya to draft minimal CSR script and share by 2025-03-12. (Action: Maya)
2) KMS role-based access: HSM vendor requires service principal with IP allowlist; team's IPs shift with jump-hosts. Next step: Alex to propose a short-term service account approach and secure tunnel pattern for approval by Sara. (Action: Alex, Sara)
3) Model download failure behind corporate proxy: observed 403s from model registry; root cause likely signed URL expiry + proxy rewrite. Next step: replicate in isolated network and extend signed URL lifetime; Maya to run repro and collect curl+tcpdump logs by 2025-03-13. (Action: Maya)
4) Load test infra missing 95th/99th percentile scenario: perf harness currently uses single-worker config. Next step: Priya to update harness and run a distributed test with KV cache warmup; tentative run 2025-03-18. (Action: Priya)

Action items (owners + due):
- Maya: Draft CSR automation snippet + example values (due 2025-03-12)
- Alex: KMS short-term service-account + secure-tunnel proposal (due 2025-03-13)
- Maya: Reproduce model download 403 and attach logs to ticket (JIRA-OPS-789) (due 2025-03-13)
- Liam: Share current firewall ACL export and service IP list (due 2025-03-13)
- Priya: Update perf harness to multi-worker and schedule distributed run (due 2025-03-17)
- Sara: Confirm HSM vendor timeline and point-of-contact for remote onboarding (due 2025-03-14)

Decisions made:
- Temporary fallback: Use Redwood-hosted artifact mirror for model pulls during initial staging to reduce friction; mirror will be retired once customer's registry/egress stability verified.
- Canary plan: Start with internal-only traffic on day-1, then 10% external traffic with automatic rollback if latency > 2s for 5m.

Notes / random context (scratchpad):
- Consider adding a 'kube-cert-manager' overlay to support CSR flow; smaller surface than full cert-manager install.
- Keep telemetry sampling low during early runs to avoid storage surge — suggest 1% traces initially.
- Need legal sign-off for HSM key residency terms — legal loop may add 7–10 business days.

Next sync: 2025-03-18 at 10:00 PT (tentative) — agenda: ingress cert status, KMS PoC demo, first distributed perf run results.

Follow-ups logged:
- Added initial notes to JIRA-OPS-789 and linked a Confluence draft (CONFLUENCE-1234). Will attach run logs there.

Scratch/To-do (notes to self):
- Prepare short demo script for KMS proof (remote HSM handshake) — include failure fallbacks.
- Pack minimal diagnostic runbook for customer's SRE on how to collect TLS/egress traces.
- Draft customer-facing rollout checklist (one-pager) to hand to Liam after ingress cert solved.

End of notes.
